# swiss_dwellings

Floor plans drawn by us from Swiss Dwellings v3.0.0 by Matthias Standfest, Michael Franzen, Yvonne Schröder,
Luis Gonzalez Medina, Yarilo Villanueva Hernandez, Jan Hendrik Buck, Yen-Ling Tan, Milena Niedzwiecka,
Rachele Colmegna (Archilyse AG), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7788422, licensed under CC BY 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Changes: the PDF, DXF and PNG drawings were rendered by us from the published geometry. We added the
drawing style, room and unit numbers, room names in an assigned language (de, fr or it), door swings and
the title block. Archilyse AG does not endorse these drawings. They are shared under CC BY 4.0.

All files: CC-BY-4.0. Credit: Swiss Dwellings v3.0.0 by Matthias Standfest, Michael Franzen, Yvonne Schröder, Luis Gonzalez Medina, Yarilo Villanueva Hernandez, Jan Hendrik Buck, Yen-Ling Tan, Milena Niedzwiecka, Rachele Colmegna (Archilyse AG), doi:10.5281/zenodo.7788422, CC BY 4.0. Drawing rendered by us from the dataset geometry (derived work; labels, language and numbering added).
